confidence_notes: The FX rate is the RBA observation for 18 Nov 2026, found through search. Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal come from crowdsourced Numbeo-type aggregates (Expatica and MyLifeElsewhere, mid-2026). Cocktail and wine by the glass were not found in search. I set the cocktail at about 2.3 times the draft beer price and the wine glass at about 2.2 times, based on typical US relationships. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. Orlando is a tourist city, so prices near theme parks vary widely and July is peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Orlando aggregate price data, with accommodation judged against other US leisure destinations such as Tampa and Miami.
